description: This file defines the MathView class for rendering and editing inline math nodes within a ProseMirror editor, including methods for rendering math, managing inner editor state, and handling user interactions.

classes.name: MathView
classes.description: A class implementing a ProseMirror NodeView for inline math nodes, supporting rendering, editing, and user interaction.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the MathView with node, view, options, and plugin key, setting up DOM elements and initial rendering.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up DOM elements and inner editor when the MathView is destroyed.

methods.name: ensureFocus
methods.description: Focuses the inner editor if it exists and the outer view has focus.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the MathView with a new node, synchronizing content and re-rendering if not editing.

methods.name: updateCursorPos
methods.description: Updates cursor position side based on the current editor state.

methods.name: selectNode
methods.description: Handles node selection, opening the inner editor if not already editing.

methods.name: deselectNode
methods.description: Handles node deselection, closing the inner editor if open.

methods.name: stopEvent
methods.description: Determines if an event should be stopped from propagating based on inner view.

methods.name: renderMath
methods.description: Renders the math content using the provided renderer, handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: dispatchInner
methods.description: Dispatches transactions from the inner editor to the outer editor, keeping content synchronized.

methods.name: openEditor
methods.description: Creates and focuses a nested ProseMirror editor for math input, with keybindings for editing behavior.

methods.name: closeEditor
methods.description: Destroys the inner editor and optionally re-renders the math content.
